Effects of subcutaneous injection. Localised pain can occur on subcutaneous injection of human recombinant erythropoietin. In comparisons of preparations it has been suggested that differ- ent excipients may affect this.1-5 It has generally been reported that epoetin alfa preparations containing citrate buffer are more painful than those with phosphate buffer, and that epoetin beta preparations are less painful than epoetin alfa preparations. 1.
